mine_news.headline: Kyshawn George: Scores game-high 33 points in loss
mine_news.body: George tallied 33 points (10-19 FG, 5-7 3Pt, 8-10 FT), four rebounds, seven assists, one steal and two blocks over 39 minutes in Friday's 139-132 loss to the Hawks.

mine_news.headline: Ty Jerome: Scores 21 points with five dimes
mine_news.body: Jerome totaled 21 points (7-14 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 5-5 FT), two rebounds and five assists over 28 minutes in Friday's 128-97 loss to the Thunder.

mine_news.headline: Victor Wembanyama: Dominates with double-double
mine_news.body: Wembanyama finished Friday's 124-109 victory over Sacramento with 30 points (10-18 FG, 4-6 3Pt, 6-9 FT), 14 rebounds, two assists and two blocks across 26 minutes.
